IS 822 : 1970 Code of procedure for inspection of weldsUDC 621.791.053 : 620.1MTD 11Reaffirmed 20191 Scope1.1 This standard covers the recommended procedures for theinspection of welds.1.1.1 This code is not limited to any specific process method ofmanufacture or type of fabrication, but is intended to be a generalguide, from wham the provisions should be selected for individualapplications.1.2 This standard does not stipulate any acceptance standards.These shall be subject to mutual agreement and would depend uponthe nature and end use of the weldment.2 ReferencesIS 2 : 1960Rules for rounding off numerical valuesIS 812 : 1957Glossary of terms relating to welding and cutting ofmetalsIS 813 : 1956Scheme of symbols for welding.IS 1500 : 1959Methodfor Brinell hardness test for steelIS 1501 : 1959 Method for Vickers hardness test forsteelIS 1586 : 1960Methods for Rockwell hardness test (B and scales) forsteelIS 1731 : 1961Dimensions for steel flats and for structural and generalengineering purposesIS 1732 : 1961Dimension for round and square Steel bars for structural and general engineering purposesIS 3658 : 1966Codeof practice for liquid penetrant flaw detectionIS 5069 : 1969Glossary of terms relating to methods of mechanicaltesting of metals
